title: 12 Best Granada's Free Tapas Culture
description: Discover the 12 best spots for authentic free tapas in Granada, Spain. From traditional fried fish to modern bites, explore local favorites and insider tips for an unforgettable culinary journey.

places.name: Bar Los Diamantes
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Gambas al Pil-Pil (shrimp with garlic and chili) or Pescadito Frito (mixed fried fish).

places.name: Bodegas Castañeda
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of their house vermouth with whatever tapa comes. If you're hungry, order a tabla de ibéricos.

places.name: La Tana
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the staff for a wine recommendation and let them surprise you with the tapa. Their cheeses and pâtés are fantastic.

places.name: Taberna La Riviera
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Patatas a lo Pobre' or 'Berenjenas Fritas con Miel' (fried eggplant with honey) if they're on offer. A caña (small beer) is always a good choice.

places.name: Bar Poe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A craft beer with a 'Surprise Tapa' or specifically ask for their Coxinha.

places.name: Casa Julio
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Boquerones Fritos (fried anchovies) or Calamares a la Romana (battered calamari).

places.name: La Bella y La Bestia
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A Tinto de Verano (red wine spritzer) and brace yourself for the huge tapa that follows!

places.name: Los Manueles
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A vermouth or local beer, and keep an eye out for their Croquetas de Jamón.

places.name: Mesón del Cepa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order a caña and enjoy whatever traditional tapa comes your way, often something stew-like.

places.name: El Bar de Fede
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A Alhambra beer and see what hot tapa comes your way – they often serve grilled items.

places.name: La Sifonería
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their many craft beers and enjoy the elevated culinary surprise.

places.name: Bar Kiki
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A local beer or wine and enjoy the Alhambra view with your complimentary tapa, which often includes a small plate of paella or stew.
